- Review inference latency/cost targets and traffic profile (QPS, burst patterns)
- Discuss compatibility (quantization, KV caching) and network/security constraints (VPC, egress)
- Identify integration blockers and mutual action plan

Proposed times (PT):
- Tue 24 Nov, 10:00-11:30am PT
- Wed 25 Nov, 2:00-3:30pm PT
- Thu 26 Nov, 9:00-10:30am PT

Can you confirm which of these works and who from your ML/infra team (names + emails) should join? I cc'd Camila (solutions engineer) - she'll run the deep dive on our side and can share an agenda/pdf.
